lede: Virginia carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.1 against +2.8, a 0.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Virginia -12.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Virginia winning 80% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is special teams, where Virginia leads Syracuse by 78 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 82% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
